'''Suleman Zaheer''' ({{lang-ur|سلیمان ظہیر}}; born 1 February 2007) is a Pakistani software engineer, technology entrepreneur, and Urdu poet from [[Lahore]], [[Pakistan]]. He is the founder and lead software architect of SAMStack Studio, a software development agency specializing in full-stack web applications, Flutter mobile apps, desktop software, and generative artificial intelligence solutions.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer – Official Digital Identity and Bio |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/bio |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Suleman Zaheer was born in Shahdara Town, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan on 1 February 2007. He completed his secondary education at Yashfeen Education System and higher secondary pre-engineering education at [[Govt Islamia College Civil Lines, Lahore]]. He subsequently enrolled at the [[University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore]] (UET Lahore), pursuing studies in computer science and software systems architecture.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer Curriculum Vitae and Credentials |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/cv |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

== Career ==
Zaheer began programming in high school, focusing on modern web standards, JavaScript runtime environments, and Python automation. 

In 2023, he established SAMStack Studio in Lahore, offering custom software engineering to businesses across Pakistan and internationally. His technical work includes:
* '''Full-Stack Web Development:''' Enterprise applications built on [[Next.js]], React, Node.js, and Laravel.
* '''Mobile Application Development:''' Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android utilizing [[Flutter]].
* '''Desktop Applications:''' Cross-platform desktop tools built using Electron.js.
* '''Automation & Scripting:''' Python-based web crawlers, data extraction pipelines, and automated messaging agents.
* '''Artificial Intelligence:''' Implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, LLM fine-tuning, and conversational AI assistants.<ref>{{cite web |title=SAMStack Studio Engineering Portfolio |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/projects |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

== Literary work ==
In addition to computer engineering, Zaheer writes Urdu poetry, composing both [[Ghazal]] and modern [[Nazm]] formats. His literary works explore themes of human introspection, philosophy, and classical South Asian aesthetic traditions.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer Urdu Poetry Archive |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/poetry |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>
